kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتشرذم (form IIq)
# أَتَشَرْذَمُ (ʔatašarḏamu) /ʔa.ta.ʃar.ða.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَشَرْذَمَ (tašarḏama)
# أَتَشَرْذَمَ (ʔatašarḏama) /ʔa.ta.ʃar.ða.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَشَرْذَمَ (tašarḏama)
# أَتَشَرْذَمْ (ʔatašarḏam) /ʔa.ta.ʃar.ðam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَشَرْذَمَ (tašarḏama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
